turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I have twenty minutes, Hale, and I'm using them on Owen. The zero came off a screen on his phone, in the middle of class, and nobody called me first. Tell me who decided that.
I'm not here to be thanked, Hale. Who decided to enter the zero, and when?
Seventeen. He lives at home with me, so he isn't an independent student, and your own procedure says I get a call before any mark goes in. Why didn't I?
A grocery store, about twenty hours a week. What does his job have to do with a zero you entered without calling me?
When did his dad move out?
That's not on the table, Hale. What does my family have to do with a zero you entered before anyone spoke to Owen?
And what day was the zero entered?
Tuesday, November 3. It's on my legal pad, and a week went by without a single call to me. Was Owen spoken to before you entered it?
What do you know about his essay so far?
It's his English 30-1 essay on Hamlet, and Owen tells me he wrote it. That's all I know, because nobody has shown me anything. What do you have, Hale?
